item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
Zabbix Toolbar 1.0.0

First public release.

  • Menu bar icon with the active problems of all your Zabbix servers (6.0 to 7.x), notifications for new problems, compact and extended lists, host group filter and an Overview in Settings.
  • Free plan: one monitored server with the full problem list and notifications.
  • Pro plan (monthly or yearly subscription, up to 2 Macs): unlimited servers, acknowledge, close and change severity in Zabbix, snooze, minimum severity and alerts per severity.
  • Signed and notarized by Apple, with automatic updates (Settings → General → Updates).
  • Server tokens and passwords stored in the macOS Keychain.
  • English interface with Brazilian Portuguese available.

Upgrading from a 0.1 test build: macOS asks for notification permission again, and "Open at login" must be turned on again in Settings → General.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
Zabbix Toolbar 1.0.1

Security and privacy improvements.

  • The app no longer follows redirects from a Zabbix server, so your token or password can't be sent to a different address. If your server redirects, the app shows the new address so you can update the server URL.
  • A warning now appears when a server URL uses http://, since the token or password would travel without encryption.
  • Your Pro license key is now stored in the macOS Keychain, like your server credentials. Existing licenses move there automatically.
  • Stricter license checks.
  • Settings → General → Privacy now lists everything the anonymous usage data contains.

If you used a test build before 1.0.0, consider creating new API tokens in Zabbix: older test builds stored them in a file.
